The FloPlast push-fit/solvent weld single socket pipe coupler provides a robust solution for connecting 110mm drainage pipes within soil and vent systems. Manufactured from high quality uPVC, this grey pipe coupler ensures long-lasting performance and resilience in various plumbing applications. Its versatile design supports both push-fit and solvent weld joint methods, offering secure and flexible installation options for trade professionals. The single socket fitting simplifies connections, making it an essential component for efficient wastewater management and drainage installations.
